rules.monthly_spy: Target100%SPY before reserve; rebalance monthly at next open.
rules.static_equal_thirds: Target1/3 each SPY/IEF/GLD before reserve; rebalance monthly at next open.
rules.equal_thirds_10m_trend_cash: At each completed month-end, a sleeve receives1/3 only if its forward-constructed total-return index exceeds its trailing10month-end mean including current month. Otherwise that sleeve stays cash, without redistribution.

future_study.decision_fill: Last common completed regular session of month; next common regular session open. Never same-close fill; daily bars cannot validate intraday execution.
future_study.dates_status: Proposed pending audited inception/common coverage/calendar and full10month warmup; no pre-inception backfill or automatic date/proxy amendment.
future_study.primary_cash_model: One USD CASH account. No borrowing. Sell-before-buy; buys use realized available cash after all modeled costs. Unpaid dividend receivables belong to wealth but are excluded from spendable cash/investable target budget.
future_study.dividends: Entitle prior eligible holdings at documented ex-date; accrue receivable; credit spendable cash only at verified payment date under declared date-level ordering. Unknown pay dates block primary tradable-cash study; do not fabricate them.
future_study.splits: Preserve raw execution prices and adjust quantities/entitlements per verified effective split action/order. Do not treat split movement as profit/loss or double-adjust.
future_study.signal_series: Forward total-return index from verified raw prices, distributions and splits; explicitly chosen reinvestment convention for signals only, separate from actual payment-cash availability. Do not use adjusted fills plus duplicate dividends.
future_study.rebalance: Use available open marks; fixed deterministic symbol order after sells, cost-aware whole-share cash feasibility, residual cash retained. Rejections/partial fills do not create assumed cash; missing marks stop/flag rather than forward-fill.
future_study.primary_criterion: At each cost: no worse full-path drawdown magnitude AND longest observed peak-to-recovery/observed-end sessions, strictly better at leastone. Drawdown fraction tolerance1e-10; duration integerexact. Cost-robustclaimrequiresbothcontexts.
future_study.growth: Report CAGR/endingwealth sacrifice separately; acceptable sacrifice not selected; path pass is not investment selection.
future_study.chronology: Continuous capital/positions/features, no annual resets. Previously viewed/publicly studied2006–2025 remains development; new tickers do not create holdout independence.
future_study.cash_comparison: Zero-return analytical cash under zero cash interest; undefined Sharpe/Calmar. Actual opportunity cost disclosed; do not import an undeclared cash-yield benefit.

execution_conventions.qualification: Every data/action/calendar/availability gate and native model gap must be resolved in a new scope before implementation or market execution. This file allocates no trials.
execution_conventions.ordering: One synthetic USD CASH account; fixed symbol order GLD, IEF, SPY. At a session: verified effective splits, entitlement and verified payment-date transfers, open marks, complete sells, then buys. Prior eligible holdings determine ex-date entitlement; same-day action ordering must be supported by source conventions, otherwise block.
execution_conventions.fractional_actions: Fractional split/distribution entitlements require verified cash-in-lieu/rounding rules; unknown rules block. Do not silently discard entitlement.
execution_conventions.pricing: Raw open marks only. Buy adverse fill=open*(1+bps/10000); sell=open*(1-bps/10000), rounded to USD cents ROUND_HALF_EVEN; USD1 fixed fee per actual filled instrument order. One market order per nonzero instrument delta; incomplete/rejected execution invalidates primary case instead of assuming fill/cash. No order splitting to alter fees.
execution_conventions.wealth: Daily NAV=USD cash+raw marked holdings+unpaid verified receivables. Spending excludes receivables. Reserve target=1% of tradable marked equity; zero cash interest; tax, market impact beyond fixed slippage and settlement restrictions unmodeled. Not broker parity.
execution_conventions.sizing: At rebalance compute B=0.99*(available cash+sum(held whole shares*raw open mark)); exclude unpaid receivables. Freeze target whole shares=floor(weight*B/raw open mark). Sell positive excess first; await actual cash/fees. In GLD,IEF,SPY order buy min(target deficit,floor(max(available cash-1,0)/adverse rounded fill)); skip zero orders. Shortfall and residual allocation reported; never borrow or presume sale proceeds.
execution_conventions.cash_timing: Payment spendability uses verified date-level start-of-session availability assumption, disclosed as daily-resolution model, not evidence of intraday broker credit. Unknown payment date blocks.
execution_conventions.signal: Forward TRI anchored100 at first valid close; per day growth=(split ratio*(current raw close+distribution per post-split share))/previous raw close, only with verified compatible event units/order. Signals use ex-date distribution reinvestment convention; actual cash arrives only on pay date. Do not add cash dividends to adjusted-close fills.
execution_conventions.monthly: Last completed common regular session of month provides TRI close and trailing10 month-end arithmetic mean including current month. Strictly greater means active; equality inactive. At least10 qualified month ends required. Next common regular open executes targets. No partial-month signal or same-close execution.
execution_conventions.missing: Missing/invalid marks, session ambiguity, unavailable signals/actions or unknown entitlement semantics stop and invalidate rather than forward-fill or change dates.
execution_conventions.metrics: Continuous capital and positions; annual/rolling NAV returns include receivables; Sharpe uses daily zero cash benchmark and sqrt252, undefined at zero sample volatility; full-path Calmar=CAGR/absolute full-path MDD, annual Calmar=calendar-year cumulative return/absolute within-year MDD including prior-year closing wealth, undefined zero MDD. Rolling and annual periods are diagnostics, not independent trials. Historical ES95 is mean of worst ceil(0.05*N) daily losses; disclose finite-sample convention. Peak-to-recovery durations count observed sessions, distinguish censored episodes.
